content:
Players familiar with Grand Theft Auto will know that Rockstar games have previously included some strange encounters. GTA 6 however, takes the obsession with extra-terrestrials to a whole new level. While previous games have featured mysterious UFO sightings and alien Easter eggs, this time there’s an entire secret questline to uncover. The GTA 6 alien quest involves a late-night abduction, a bizarre dream filled with puzzles and a secret research facility hiding something rather extraordinary. Better still, completing the entire quest rewards both Jason and Lucia with permanent upgrades to their Health, Stamina and Focus stats.

Finding the alien unfortunately isn’t quite as simple as heading to a marked location on your map. So for those wishing to complete the mission, here’s everything you need to know about starting the GTA 6 Alien Dreams quest, solving its puzzles and claiming your rewards.

How to Start the Alien Quest in GTA 6

Before you can begin the alien questline, you’ll need to have reached Chapter 2 of GTA 6. The first encounter is a random event that occurs at night, so there’s no guaranteed way to trigger it immediately. One reported location is along the quiet trails northwest of the Starlet Motel, particularly after 2 AM. Other players have encountered the event on remote roads around Port Gellhorn and northern Kelly County (which is where we discovered it).

Keep an eye out for an abandoned car with its doors open and headlights flashing. This is your first indication that something unusual is happening nearby. Once you’ve spotted the vehicle, follow the trail leading away from it until you come across a woman being lifted into the sky by a mysterious beam of light. Approach her, and the UFO will disappear. Speak to the woman and agree to retrieve her car.

As you make your way back towards the vehicle, you’ll experience an alien abduction of your own!

When your character eventually wakes up, several in-game days will have passed, and you’ll have unlocked The Truth Is Out There trophy or achievement.

How to Trigger the Alien Dream in GTA 6

The next stage of the mission takes place while your character is asleep. Head to your safehouse and get into bed. The alien dream sequence does appear to trigger randomly, so don’t worry if nothing happens on your first attempt. If you need to, continue playing as normal, and return to sleep later. When the event does trigger, you’ll wake up in a strange, white room aboard what appears to be an alien spacecraft.

GTA 6 Alien Dream Puzzle Solutions

The dream contains several puzzles that you’ll need to complete before you can progress to the next stage of the quest.

How to Get Past the Alien Eggs

After leaving the first room, you’ll enter an area filled with mysterious alien eggs. The trick here is to avoid disturbing them. Crouch down and carefully move along the left side of the room, keeping your distance from the eggs wherever possible. If too many eggs burst, a tentacle will grab your character and force you to restart this section. Make it safely to the door at the opposite end to continue.

Find the Secret Location in the Planet Room

The next room contains a model of the solar system, with an interactive orb in the centre. Approach the orb and examine the image displayed inside it. You’ll see a mysterious location somewhere in Leonida, featuring a fenced-off building and a large tower. Pay close attention to the surroundings, as this is the location you’ll need to visit later. Once you’ve examined the image, another door will open, allowing you to continue towards the keypad puzzle.

GTA 6 Alien Keypad Code Solution

The next obstacle is a locked door requiring a four-digit code. Fortunately, the solution is hidden directly above the keypad. Look for the groups of horizontal lines displayed above the numbers. Each group represents a digit based on the number of lines shown.

The code can vary between playthroughs, so you’ll need to count the lines on your own keypad rather than relying on a fixed combination. Enter the correct code to unlock the door.

How to Solve the Alien Light Puzzle

Your next challenge involves a control panel featuring four lights and four smaller buttons. The objective is to turn all four lights blue. Each light cycles through three states: off, red and blue. However, some buttons affect multiple lights at once, making the puzzle a little more complicated than it initially appears.

Numbering the four buttons from left to right, one reported solution is:

  1. Press the main button.
  2. Press button 4.
  3. Press button 3.
  4. Press button 4 again.
  5. Press button 3 again.
  6. Press button 1.
  7. Pull the lever.

This sequence has been reported to work from the puzzle’s starting state. If you’ve already pressed other buttons, you may need to reset the puzzle or adjust the lights individually.

Once all four lights are blue, pulling the lever will unlock three doors.

Complete the Alien Milk Puzzle

With the three doors unlocked, head through the door on the left. Inside, you’ll find a container of mysterious milk sitting on a table. Pick it up and return to the main room. Now enter the door on the right and place the milk into the machine. Avoid the middle door, as it contains a dangerous radiation hazard.

Completing this final interaction brings the dream sequence to an end, and your character will wake up safely at home. However, the location you saw inside the mysterious orb wasn’t just part of a dream. It’s a real place you can visit.

Where to Find the Secret Alien Facility in GTA 6

After completing the dream, your next objective is to locate the building shown inside the orb. The location is linked to a secluded research compound in Leonida. Guides have reported different facility locations, including a swamp compound south of Hamlet in Pelican Valley and a facility near Southpoint Airfield in Mariana County. We found it here:

Use the location revealed in your own dream to identify the correct compound. Once you’ve found the facility, you’ll need to get inside. Depending on the entrance, you may be able to force your way through a gate or use a larger vehicle to climb over the surrounding fence.

Head towards the main building and look for the locked entrance leading underground. You’ll encounter another keypad, but thankfully, you already know the solution. Enter the same four-digit code you discovered during your alien dream, then use the elevator to descend into the facility.

How to Rescue the Alien in GTA 6

Once you’re underground, follow the corridors until you reach a familiar control room. You’ll recognise the four-light puzzle from your dream, along with the three mysterious doors. Complete the puzzle again, ensuring that all four lights turn blue before pulling the lever. Next, retrieve the container of milk from the room on the left and carry it to the room on the right, just as you did previously. This time, however, completing the puzzle will reveal an actual alien. Pick up the extra-terrestrial and make your way back towards the elevator as quickly as possible, as the underground facility begins filling with dangerous gas. Return to the surface with your new companion to trigger a cutscene.

An alien spacecraft will arrive to collect the creature you’ve rescued, but your escape isn’t quite over yet. Government agents will surround your character, seemingly leaving you with nowhere to go. Fortunately, the aliens haven’t forgotten your help. The spacecraft returns and eliminates the agents, before sending a final message of thanks using Morse code. With the alien safely rescued, the questline is complete.

GTA 6 Alien Quest Rewards – Permanent Health, Stamina and Focus Upgrades

Completing the alien rescue quest rewards you with a permanent increases to Health, Stamina and Focus for both Jason and Lucia. These upgrades are applied automatically, meaning you won’t need to purchase any additional equipment or collect a special item.

Unfortunately, you won’t receive an alien spaceship or a futuristic ray gun as a reward, although the permanent stat improvements are arguably much more useful.

Considering the quest can be started relatively early in the game, it’s well worth tracking down the initial abduction encounter rather than leaving it until you’ve completed the main story.
